-- Phase 2: bodies for the frozen spec.

-- Maps any integer i into the index range [0, n).
wrap_index(i: int, n: int) -> int =
  pre n > 0
  post out >= 0
  post out < n
  ex wrap_index(7, 3) == 1
  ex wrap_index(-1, 3) == 2
  i % n

-- Returns a permutation of xs chosen by seed alone.
-- Uses no capabilities, so the result depends only on xs and seed.
shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre seed >= 0
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 5) == []
  ex shuffled([7], 42) == [7]
  -- Work on a copy so the caller's list is untouched.
  var res: List[int] = []
  for x in xs
    res.append(x)
  -- Reduce the seed first so the LCG product stays within 64 bits.
  var state = seed % 2147483648
  var i = res.len() - 1
  -- Fisher-Yates: swap each position i with a position j in [0, i].
  while i > 0
    state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648
    let j = wrap_index(state, i + 1)
    let t = res[i]
    res[i] = res[j]
    res[j] = t
    i -= 1
  res
